terms.title: Terms & Conditions

terms.sec1_desc: Service bookings are processed dynamically on this platform or via verified WhatsApp requests. We work toward our 2-hour deployment baseline, but execution speeds may adapt due to gate validation protocols or local block accessibility restrictions.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our residential RO sales and society service network.
faq.q1: What is the average tap water TDS level in Noida and Gurgaon?
faq.a1: Groundwater in high-rise societies across Noida and Gurgaon commonly reads between 1,200 to 2,500+ PPM. Standard municipal tap water usually stays below 800 PPM. We test your water for free and configure a 100 GPD heavy-duty system optimized specifically for your society's hardness profile.
faq.q2: What parts are covered under your 1-Year Hardware Warranty?
faq.a2: Our comprehensive 1-year warranty explicitly covers crucial operating electronics including the booster pump, SMPS electrical unit, and solenoid control valves. Filters and membranes are consumables subject to clogging from external dust/mud particles and are maintained under our active AMC protection plans.
faq.q3: How long does it take for a technician to arrive after booking?
faq.a3: We maintain a 2-hour technician deployment baseline for high-density hubs like Noida Extension, Dwarka, and Gurgaon Phase 5. Once you submit a booking request or ping us on WhatsApp, a certified technician is assigned and scheduled directly to your tower block.
faq.q4: How can our society unlock the Resident Group Discount?
faq.a4: If you club filter replacement or AMC maintenance purchases with 3 or more neighbors in the same apartment building or tower block, we apply a flat 15% discount to the collective order invoice. You can arrange this directly by pinging our team on WhatsApp.
